candidate.title: Disqus importer is no longer idempotent: reruns duplicate all replies when TopicEmbed.import_remote returns an existing post
reports: lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — importremote now returns the existing post for threads already imported, but the reply loop that follows is not idempotent, so re-running the import appends a second copy of every disqus comment to the existing topics (p2, conf 75)

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — return-value contract changed: postcreatorcreate always made a new post, while importremote returns nil for non-http links and returns the pre-existing post when the embed row already exists, so re-running the importer appends duplicate replies to an existing topic

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — [p1, confidence 100] post = topicembed.importremote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title]) lets one unavailable source url abort the import after earlier threads committed, and rerunning then re-enters those existing topics and creates their replies again, duplicating already-imported comments.
